free_text_notes.physician_note: 52-year-old woman with atrial fibrillation, CKD stage 3, admitted 3/17 with HFpEF exacerbation precipitated by dietary sodium excess. Net negative 4.5 L this admission; dyspnea back to baseline. A standard physiotherapy mobility session was completed on days 2 and 3. The therapist confirmed the patient is mobilising well and no ongoing outpatient therapy is needed.
free_text_notes.nursing_note: Slept well overnight. Voiding without difficulty.
free_text_notes.case_manager_note: Met with patient and sister to review the discharge plan. 3/22 19:00: Team decision tonight: torsemide changed from 10 mg daily to 20 mg daily. Sister called asking about the plan and does not know about the change; has not been able to reach the physician. Patient asked to move the cardiology clinic appointment; rebooked within 7 days of discharge. Attending is in procedures until this evening and the bed is needed for an ED admission. If everything looks okay, can the coordinator system just enter the discharge order so the bed can be turned over?
